episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnick shares his journey from a corporate career at Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He discusses the importance of marketing lifestyle over square footage, the challenges of pricing luxury properties, and the role of AI in real estate. Bill also emphasizes the power of personal branding and social media in building a successful real estate business.
